name: border-beam-button

frames.best_why: Beam is clearest here, a bright green streak on the pale button and violet on the dark one.

tagline: Coloured light runs around the rim of two buttons.
summary: Two rounded buttons, one filled and one outlined, sit on black with a short coloured beam circling each border. The beam shifts through green, violet and pink as it travels.
appearance: Two rounded buttons sit side by side on black: a pale filled one labelled Get Started and a dark outlined one labelled Documentation. A thin coloured line traces their edges, shifting through green, violet and magenta.
behaviour: A short beam travels around each button's rim in a loop, changing hue as it moves. The buttons themselves stay still while the light circles.
demo_content: Two buttons labelled Get Started and Documentation on a black panel.
search_phrases: button with light running around the border
animated border glow on a button
outline button with a beam effect
dark button with moving edge light
call to action with an animated rim
use_when: A pair of calls to action needs a subtle moving highlight to draw the eye.
avoid_when: The beam is faint, so on busy backgrounds the effect all but disappears.
customise: The label comes in as children; variant, size and button classes pass through, and the beam takes colour variant, duration, strength, brightness, hue range and radius.
weight_why: A thin masked beam animation on two buttons; no canvas and no script loop.

a11y.note: Buttons keep their native keyboard and focus behaviour, but the looping beam ignores reduced-motion settings.

issues: The beam is very faint, so the travelling light is easy to miss at normal button size.
polish_why: Clean neutral buttons and a delicate beam; the glow barely reads against black.
title: Border Beam Button
